description: From the ravine area, the great cliff face of Risco Caído rises dark against the night sky — the sacred mountain of the island's indigenous people, its cave openings hidden in shadow on the rock face. The ravine falls away below in darkness while the cliff's bulk fills the frame. This is Gran Canaria's most sacred pre-Hispanic site, a temple of the island's ancient sky-watchers; by night it keeps its mysteries.
